scope: Additional ROS 2 topic interface; raw XML/GeoJSON, actual ROS transport, actual MongoDB reads and updates in owned test database

resolved_defects.issue: Two GeoJSON reads could mix previous coordinates with replacement radii
resolved_defects.fix: Parse graph geometry and radius metadata from a single input snapshot

resolved_defects.issue: A newer static record could replace the intended dynamic machine blackboard
resolved_defects.fix: Filter by type=dynamic as well as the input-derived model and record name

resolved_defects.issue: Restoring SIGINT before interpreter teardown allowed a second Ctrl+C to terminate the child abnormally
resolved_defects.fix: Ignore repeated SIGINT throughout node cleanup and remaining process teardown
resolved_defects.regression_test: Actual ROS double-SIGINT tests at 10, 80 and 200 milliseconds

actual_ros_runtime_boundary_cases.mongo: read-only mock with mutable documents; no actual DB access or writes
limitations: Unity client is not connected; acknowledgements use a real ROS2 test peer.
These boundary cases use a strict read-only MongoClient stub; real MongoDB verification is performed separately.
